Recently, I had the pleasure of being interviewed by Authority Magazine, and they had done their homework and asked all the right questions, so we covered a lot of territory.

 

One of their questions hit on one of my favorite points about the failure to treat Cannabis prohibition as a serious issue. Frankly, it still really puzzles me.
